_doc: Non-gameplay visual routes (plan 3.3): worn ground that gives direction, no movement restriction. Points are world x,z (m). core_width = compacted walking centre (param, plan 1.4-2.4 m), varied along the route by width_jitter; shoulder = trampled, thinner vegetation each side; clearance_height = crowns/shrubs must not intrude below this height inside core+shoulder (tested with asset footprints, not origins). Margins are broken by noise; 'stones_on_turns' exposes gravel/stones where the route bends; 'roots' allows bare roots where it crosses mature forest.

routes.note: spawn meadow -> short wooded passage (-50..-66) -> rock-ledged bend (-72,-177) -> down to the river bank pocket (-56,-201). ~95 m.
